'''Rewna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] who served as an apprentice mechanic in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in which they fought the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At the end of the war the [[Sa Nalaor/Legends|''Sa Nalaor'']], the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] on which Rewna served, fled Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and ended up crashing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]]. Rewna along with a number of other crew members survived the crash and set up a settlement known as [[the Retreat]], where they survived into the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Rewna was middle aged and ran the droid repair shop in the Retreat, a job that was important enough to give her second priority in the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] of [[Rel Harsol]], the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the ''Sa Nalaor'' and leader of the survivors. Rewna made the most of the situation but truly wished to leave Cholganna and return to civilized space, something Harsol was aware of. She was aided at times by an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] named [[R5-J1]], although it often broke down.<ref name="BTR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Rewna was present at the Retreat when a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] and group of [[Yiyar salvage corporation]] employees who were searching for the ''Sa Nalaor'' were brought in by Harsol. The spacers and salvagers remained in the Retreat until it was visited by the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]], after which the spacers escaped.<ref name="BTR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Rewna first appeared in [[2013]] in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'' an adventure module written by [[Sterling Hershey]] for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] roleplaying game, ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''. She was included as someone that players could potentially interact with whilst in the Retreat. Players have several options in the Retreat, and can end up fighting the survivors and/or the Imperials or end up transporting at least some of the survivors off of Cholganna.
